name: What type of paint is best for kitchen cabinets?

mainEntity.name: What type of paint is best for kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: For kitchen cabinets, durable and hard-wearing paints are essential due to high traffic and moisture. We typically recommend high-quality acrylic or enamel paints, often with a semi-gloss or satin finish for easy cleaning and resistance to grease and grime. Lacquer-based paints can also provide an excellent, smooth finish. We prioritize paints that offer good adhesion, scuff resistance, and a long-lasting appearance. Our experts can discuss the pros and cons of different paint types during your consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Durable acrylic or enamel paints with a semi-gloss or satin finish are best for kitchen cabinets due to moisture and traffic. Lacquer-based paints also work well. We help select the ideal option.
